reason: The free app already does the real stuff, so I don't feel scammed, and the extras are the aesthetic things I'd screenshot for my story: the room, the widgets, the icons. One time, no subscription, so I'd probably pay once if I'm still using it after a couple of weeks.
objection: I only pay if I'm still opening the app. If my pet stops feeling fun after two weeks it's $7 of cute stuff I don't use. Also the soundscapes are wasted on me, my phone is always on vibrate.
would_change_my_mind: If any of the basic stuff I use daily got moved behind Plus later, or if I couldn't see the room and species before paying.
